entries.title: Pew 2026-06 Americans and AI 2026
entries.summary_zh: 约一半美国成年人用过 AI 聊天工具，比 2024 年夏天明显增加。
entries.summary_en: About half of U.S. adults now report using AI chatbots, up substantially from the summer of 2024.

entries.path: 10_资料库/Pew 2026-06 How Opinions and Use of AI Differ by Age.md
entries.title: Pew 2026-06 How Opinions and Use of AI Differ by Age
entries.summary_zh: 50 岁以下的成年人更常每天使用聊天工具，约三分之一每天使用。
entries.summary_en: Daily chatbot use is also more common among adults under age 50. A third of adults under 50 say they use these tools daily.

entries.path: 10_资料库/Pew 2026-06 Why Don’t People Use Chatbots.md
entries.title: Pew 2026-06 Why Don’t People Use Chatbots
entries.summary_zh: 不用聊天工具的原因：不感兴趣（主要原因 60%、次要 23%、合计 83%），担心个人信息怎么用（54%、24%、79%），不信任准确性（45%、30%、76%）。
entries.summary_en: Not interested in using them 60% 23% 83% Concerned about how their personal information will be used 54% 24% 79% Don’t trust them to give accurate information 45% 30% 76%

entries.path: 10_资料库/Ping Identity 2026-06 Consumer Survey AI Trust.md
entries.title: Ping Identity 2026-06 Consumer Survey AI Trust
entries.summary_zh: 用户愿意给的权限有限：即使每周能省五小时，也只有 33% 愿意给 AI 代理开放主邮箱的只读权限。
entries.summary_en: The kind of access they’re willing to grant is also limited, with only 33% indicating willingness to give an agent “read” access to their primary email inbox, even in exchange for saving five hours per week.

entries.title: 联想 2026-09 Qira扩展
entries.summary_zh: 联想把 Qira 扩展到 80 多种商用和消费 PC 配置，以及部分平板和摩托罗拉手机。
entries.summary_en: Since the initial rollout earlier this year, Lenovo has brought Lenovo & Motorola Qira to more than 80 supported PC configurations across its commercial and consumer portfolios, as well as select tablets and Motorola smartphones.

entries.title: 联想 2026-01 Qira发布
entries.summary_zh: Qira 是一个在联想和摩托罗拉设备之间一致延续的个人智能。
entries.summary_en: Lenovo Qira is a single intelligence carried consistently across Lenovo and Motorola devices.

entries.path: 10_资料库/联想 2026-08 FY26-27 Q1 业绩.md
entries.title: 联想 2026-08 FY26-27 Q1 业绩
entries.summary_zh: 联想 AI PC 全球第一，AI PC 份额升至 25.1%。
entries.summary_en: Lenovo continues to be the global #1 in AI PCs, with AI PC market share increasing to 25.1%.

entries.path: 10_资料库/TechRadar 2025-07 企业并不急着买AI PC.md
entries.title: TechRadar 2025-07 企业并不急着买AI PC
entries.summary_zh: 调研发现 73% 知道 Copilot+ PC，但只有 33% 认为 AI 是重要的购买因素。
entries.summary_en: Report finds 73% are aware of Copilot+ PCs, but only 33% see AI as important purchasing factors
